raw: {"report": "Axial CT images of the chest demonstrate diffuse, bilateral ground-glass opacities and interlobular septal thickening throughout both lungs. There is no evidence of focal consolidation, pleural effusion, or pneumothorax. The mediastinal structures appear unremarkable in size and configuration.", "findings": [{"finding": "ground glass opacity", "status": "present"}, {"finding": "interlobular septal thickening", "status": "present"}]}

{"report": "The sagittal CT image demonstrates a large, well-defined fluid collection in the anterior mediastinum with an air-fluid level. The corresponding T1-weighted MRI with gadolinium shows this lesion as hypointense and non-enhancing, consistent with a simple fluid collection.", "findings": [{"finding": "pleural effusion", "status": "absent"}, {"finding": "hydrocephalus", "status": "absent"}, {"finding": "splenomegaly", "status": "absent"}]}

{"report": "Axial CT images of the chest demonstrate a large, contrast-filled structure in the anterior mediastinum consistent with the ascending aorta. There is an irregular filling defect within the lumen of the ascending aorta, suggestive of intraluminal thrombus or dissection flap. The descending thoracic aorta appears patent without evidence of mural thrombus or dissection.", "findings": [{"finding": "aortic dissection", "status": "absent"}, {"finding": "intraluminal thrombus", "status": "present"}]}

{"report": "This is an upper GI series with contrast demonstrating the esophagus and trachea. There is a smooth, tapered narrowing of the distal esophagus with a dilated proximal segment, creating a 'bird's beak' appearance. The contrast column appears to terminate abruptly at this point of stenosis.", "findings": [{"finding": "esophageal stricture", "status": "present"}]}

{"report": "There is a large, complex fluid collection in the right hemithorax with an air-fluid level and internal gas locules. The mediastinum is shifted to the left by this mass effect. The lung parenchyma on the right appears compressed.", "findings": [{"finding": "pneumomediastinum", "status": "absent"}, {"finding": "pleural effusion", "status": "present"}]}

{"report": "Axial CT image of the chest demonstrates a large, heterogeneous mass in the anterior mediastinum with central low attenuation suggestive of necrosis. There is associated enlargement of the right pulmonary artery and left main pulmonary artery. Multiple small nodular opacities are scattered throughout both lung fields.", "findings": [{"finding": "mediastinal mass", "status": "present"}, {"finding": "pulmonary embolism", "status": "absent"}, {"finding": "lung nodules", "status": "present"}]}

{"report": "Axial CT images of the abdomen demonstrate a large, heterogeneously enhancing mass arising from the left adrenal gland. The mass exhibits areas of high attenuation consistent with hemorrhage or calcification and causes significant displacement of adjacent structures including the stomach and spleen. No other focal hepatic lesions are identified.", "findings": [{"finding": "adrenal mass", "status": "present"}]}

{"report": "There is a large, heterogeneous mass arising from the right kidney with areas of low attenuation suggestive of necrosis or cystic change. The mass demonstrates enhancement following contrast administration and causes significant distortion of the renal architecture. The left kidney appears normal in size and enhancement pattern.", "findings": [{"finding": "renal mass", "status": "present"}]}

{"report": "There is a large, well-defined, hypodense collection in the left upper quadrant, consistent with fluid density. The spleen appears enlarged and displaced by this collection. No free air is seen within the abdomen.", "findings": [{"finding": "splenomegaly", "status": "present"}, {"finding": "ascites", "status": "absent"}]}

{"report": "The noncontrast CT demonstrates a hypodense lesion in the right parietal lobe with surrounding edema and mass effect. There is no evidence of intracranial hemorrhage or midline shift.", "findings": [{"finding": "intracranial hemorrhage", "status": "absent"}, {"finding": "mass effect", "status": "present"}]}

{"report": "There is a large, heterogeneous soft tissue mass located in the region of the pancreatic body and tail. The mass demonstrates irregular borders and appears to encase or abut the adjacent splenic vessels. There is associated stranding in the surrounding peripancreatic fat.", "findings": [{"finding": "pancreatic mass", "status": "present"}]}

{"report": "Axial CT images of the head and neck demonstrate a large, well-circumscribed, hypodense mass in the right parotid region with internal septations. The lesion causes significant mass effect on adjacent structures without evidence of bony erosion or invasion into surrounding soft tissues. No similar findings are noted on the contralateral side.", "findings": [{"finding": "parotid mass", "status": "present"}]}

{"report": "Axial and coronal CT images demonstrate a large, well-circumscribed, heterogeneously enhancing mass arising from the right kidney. The left kidney appears normal in size and enhancement pattern. There is no evidence of hydronephrosis or perinephric stranding.", "findings": [{"finding": "renal mass", "status": "present"}, {"finding": "hydronephrosis", "status": "absent"}]}

{"report": "Axial contrast-enhanced CT images demonstrate a large, heterogeneous mass in the right lobe of the liver with areas of hypodensity. The spleen appears enlarged relative to the liver size. No ascites or pleural effusion is evident.", "findings": [{"finding": "hepatocellular carcinoma", "status": "absent"}, {"finding": "splenomegaly", "status": "present"}]}

{"report": "The first image demonstrates a hyperdense lesion in the right orbit with associated proptosis and bony erosion of the orbital walls. The second image reveals a large, well-circumscribed, homogeneously enhancing mass in the right frontal lobe with surrounding vasogenic edema and mild midline shift.", "findings": [{"finding": "orbital mass", "status": "present"}, {"finding": "intracranial mass", "status": "present"}]}

{"report": "There is a large, heterogeneous soft tissue mass occupying the left hemithorax with extension into the chest wall and pectoral musculature. The mass demonstrates areas of calcification and appears to be causing significant mass effect on the adjacent lung parenchyma. No pleural effusion or pneumothorax is identified.", "findings": [{"finding": "pleural effusion", "status": "absent"}, {"finding": "pneumothorax", "status": "absent"}]}

{"report": "The CT image demonstrates a markedly enlarged abdomen with multiple calcified structures within the thoracic and abdominal cavities, consistent with ossified elements. The MR T2-weighted image reveals a large, heterogeneous mass occupying the majority of the abdominal cavity, displacing surrounding organs. There is no evidence of hydrocephalus or significant intracranial abnormality on the provided views.", "findings": [{"finding": "abdominal mass", "status": "present"}, {"finding": "hydrocephalus", "status": "absent"}]}

{"report": "The CT image demonstrates a large, well-defined soft tissue mass in the anterior compartment of the thigh with internal calcifications. The corresponding T2-weighted MRI shows this lesion as predominantly hyperintense with some hypointense areas, suggesting fluid or myxoid components. There is no evidence of cortical bone invasion or significant surrounding edema.", "findings": [{"finding": "soft tissue mass", "status": "present"}, {"finding": "calcification", "status": "present"}]}

{"report": "Axial CT image of the abdomen demonstrates a vertebral body with loss of normal height and cortical irregularity at the posterior aspect. There is associated disruption of the posterior elements, including the spinous process and laminae. The spinal canal appears patent without evidence of significant retropulsion or cord compression.", "findings": [{"finding": "vertebral fracture", "status": "present"}]}

{"report": "Axial CT image of the abdomen demonstrates a large, heterogeneous mass arising from the left kidney. The mass exhibits areas of low attenuation consistent with necrosis or cystic change and contains a central calcification. There is associated enlargement of the left renal parenchyma compared to the right side.", "findings": [{"finding": "renal mass", "status": "present"}, {"finding": "necrosis", "status": "present"}, {"finding": "calcification", "status": "present"}]}

{"report": "Axial CT images of the abdomen in a 2-year-old female demonstrate a large, heterogeneous mass arising from the right kidney. The lesion exhibits mixed attenuation with areas of lower density suggestive of necrosis or cystic change, and it causes significant distortion of the renal architecture. There is no evidence of calcification within the mass on these slices.", "findings": [{"finding": "renal mass", "status": "present"}]}

{"report": "Axial CT image of the chest demonstrates a large, rounded, contrast-filled structure in the anterior mediastinum consistent with the ascending aorta. The descending thoracic aorta is also visualized posteriorly and appears patent. No evidence of pleural effusion or pneumothorax is seen.", "findings": [{"finding": "pleural effusion", "status": "absent"}, {"finding": "pneumothorax", "status": "absent"}]}

{"report": "The noncontrast image demonstrates a large, well-defined hypodense mass in the left upper quadrant, consistent with a fluid collection. On the contrast-enhanced image, this lesion remains hypodense relative to the enhancing spleen and liver parenchyma, indicating it does not enhance. The splenic parenchyma itself appears heterogeneous with areas of lower attenuation compared to the liver.", "findings": [{"finding": "splenomegaly", "status": "present"}, {"finding": "splenic laceration", "status": "absent"}, {"finding": "hemoperitoneum", "status": "absent"}]}

{"report": "Axial CT images of the abdomen demonstrate a large, heterogeneous mass arising from the liver with areas of low attenuation suggestive of necrosis. The lesion appears to cause mass effect on adjacent structures, including displacement of the stomach and compression of the inferior vena cava. No evidence of ascites or pleural effusion is seen.", "findings": [{"finding": "liver mass", "status": "present"}, {"finding": "ascites", "status": "absent"}]}

{"report": "Axial CT images of the abdomen demonstrate a large, hypodense mass in the region of the pancreatic head/uncinate process. The mass appears to cause dilation of the intrahepatic biliary tree and likely obstructs the common bile duct. There is no evidence of distant metastatic disease or ascites.", "findings": [{"finding": "pancreatic mass", "status": "present"}, {"finding": "biliary dilation", "status": "present"}]}

{"report": "Axial CT image of the chest demonstrates a large, heterogeneous mass in the anterior mediastinum with areas of calcification. The mass appears to be compressing adjacent mediastinal structures and is located within the thymic region. No significant pleural effusion or pneumothorax is identified.", "findings": [{"finding": "anterior mediastinal mass", "status": "present"}, {"finding": "pleural effusion", "status": "absent"}]}

{"report": "The noncontrast CT demonstrates a large, hypodense area in the right hemisphere with associated mass effect and midline shift. The ventricles are compressed on the right side, and there is effacement of the right lateral ventricle. On the T1-weighted MRI, corresponding to the same region, there is an area of hypointensity with surrounding edema and mass effect, causing distortion of the adjacent structures.", "findings": [{"finding": "mass effect", "status": "present"}, {"finding": "midline shift", "status": "present"}, {"finding": "ventricular compression", "status": "present"}]}

{"report": "Axial CT images of the abdomen demonstrate a large, heterogeneous mass arising from the right kidney. The lesion exhibits mixed attenuation with areas of hypodensity suggestive of necrosis or cystic change and peripheral enhancement. There is associated dilation of the renal pelvis and calyces, consistent with hydronephrosis. No obvious lymphadenopathy or distant metastases are visualized in this single slice.", "findings": [{"finding": "renal mass", "status": "present"}, {"finding": "hydronephrosis", "status": "present"}]}

{"report": "The CT image demonstrates a large, hypodense mass in the region of the pancreas with associated dilation of the pancreatic duct. The MR T2-weighted image shows this lesion as hyperintense with internal heterogeneity and surrounding edema. There is no evidence of biliary obstruction or significant lymphadenopathy.", "findings": [{"finding": "pancreatic mass", "status": "present"}, {"finding": "pancreatic duct dilation", "status": "present"}]}

{"report": "Coronal CT images of the orbits demonstrate bilateral enlargement of the extraocular muscles, most prominently involving the inferior recti. The affected muscles appear fusiform in shape with homogeneous soft tissue density, without evidence of calcification or hemorrhage. There is no associated proptosis or bony erosion noted.", "findings": [{"finding": "bilateral thyroid eye disease", "status": "present"}]}

{"report": "The CT image demonstrates bilateral proptosis with enlargement of the extraocular muscles, particularly the medial recti. The MRI confirms symmetric enlargement of the extraocular muscles on T2-weighted imaging without significant mass effect or orbital fat stranding.", "findings": [{"finding": "bilateral proptosis", "status": "present"}, {"finding": "extraocular muscle enlargement", "status": "present"}]}

{"report": "Axial CT image of the neck demonstrates a large, heterogeneous soft tissue mass in the anterior midline, centered at the level of the thyroid cartilage. The mass appears to be arising from the laryngeal framework and is causing significant mass effect on the adjacent airway structures. There is associated widening of the prevertebral soft tissues and displacement of surrounding musculature.", "findings": [{"finding": "laryngeal mass", "status": "present"}]}

{"report": "Axial CT images of the chest demonstrate extensive bilateral interstitial lung disease. There is diffuse reticular opacification with prominent honeycombing, particularly in the subpleural regions of both lungs. The findings are more pronounced in the posterior and basal segments. No significant pleural effusion or pneumothorax is identified.", "findings": [{"finding": "honeycombing", "status": "present"}, {"finding": "reticular opacities", "status": "present"}]}

{"report": "Axial CT images of the abdomen demonstrate a large, well-defined, hypodense mass in the region of the pancreatic head/uncinate process. The lesion appears to cause some mass effect on adjacent structures but maintains relatively distinct margins from surrounding parenchyma. No obvious calcifications or cystic components are clearly visualized within the lesion on these slices.", "findings": [{"finding": "pancreatic mass", "status": "present"}]}
